requirement: Report the changed, renamed and untracked files of a git repository by running git status in its NUL-separated porcelain format and parsing it without mangling unusual file names.
skeleton: A frozen StatusEntry dataclass, a StatusParseError ValueError subclass, parse_porcelain splitting NUL fields and pairing rename and copy originals, and git_status running git with -z and all untracked files.
caption: Reading git status through subprocess in the machine format. StatusEntry is a frozen dataclass of the index and worktree status letters, the path, and an optional orig_path. StatusParseError is a ValueError subclass. parse_porcelain(data) decodes utf-8 with surrogateescape, splits on NUL, drops the empty field after the final terminator, and reads records of two status letters, a space, and the path kept verbatim. A record shorter than four characters or without the space raises StatusParseError. When the index letter is R or C the next field is the original path, and a missing one raises StatusParseError. git_status(repo) runs git -C repo status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all with check=True so a failing git raises, and parses stdout. The fixture asserts that paths with a newline or trailing space survive, that renames and copies pair with their originals, that empty output is clean, that malformed and truncated input raise StatusParseError, and that a real repository reports an untracked nested file, a modification and a rename.

plan.intent: Let a tool list pending changes in any repository
constraints: Paths are kept verbatim, including spaces and newlines
R and C records consume the following original path
Malformed or truncated records raise StatusParseError

rationale.teaches: Use -z porcelain output so names need no unquoting, parse the terminator and rename pairs exactly, and never strip path text.
rationale.why: Line-based parsing breaks on newlines in names, strip corrupts real paths, and missing the copy pairing shifts every later record.

ops.docstring: Parse ``git status --porcelain=v1 -z`` output into typed entries.

ops.source:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StatusEntry:
    """One path reported by git status."""

    index: str
    worktree: str
    path: str
    orig_path: str | None = None

class StatusParseError(ValueError):
    """Raised when porcelain output is malformed."""

def parse_porcelain(data: bytes) -> list[StatusEntry]:
    """Parse NUL-separated porcelain v1 records, pairing renames and copies."""
    fields = data.decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape").split("\0")
    if fields and fields[-1] == "":
        fields.pop()
    entries: list[StatusEntry] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(fields):
        record = fields[i]
        if len(record) < 4 or record[2] != " ":
            raise StatusParseError(f"malformed record {record!r}")
        index, worktree, path = record[0], record[1], record[3:]
        orig_path = None
        if index in {"R", "C"}:
            i += 1
            if i >= len(fields):
                raise StatusParseError(f"missing original path for {path!r}")
            orig_path = fields[i]
        entries.append(StatusEntry(index, worktree, path, orig_path))
        i += 1
    return entries

def git_status(repo: Path) -> list[StatusEntry]:
    """Return the status entries of the repository at ``repo``."""
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-C",
            str(repo),
            "status",
            "--porcelain=v1",
            "-z",
            "--untracked-files=all",
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=30,
    )
    return parse_porcelain(result.stdout)

candidates.why_wrong: Without -z git emits newline separated records that the NUL parser merges.
The empty field after the final NUL is parsed as a malformed record.
Stripping the path removes real leading or trailing spaces from file names.
Copy records do not consume their original path, shifting later records.
A truncated rename raises IndexError instead of StatusParseError.
